overview.description: The WisdomTree US Adaptive Moving Average Fund (WAMA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund tracks an index that utilizes a 200-day moving average strategy to dynamically switch investments between US equities and short-term treasury bills. Selection and weighting are based on momentum. WAMA was launched on Mar 12, 2026 and is issued by WisdomTree.

data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--WisdomTree today launched the U.S. Adaptive Moving Average Fund (WAMA) and the International Adaptive Moving Average Fund (WIMA).
